$comment: The ONE drift manifest (plan 01 §7, plan 05 §3.1 step 4; src/drift/types.ts DriftManifest is its exact type; scripts/probe.ts and src/drift read this file). `probes`: the daily probe's checks (plan 06 §1.2) — `required` is hand-written from research 03 §A.2/§B (a missing key or a wrong type is red drift, exit 4); `observed` is every key seen in the recorded fixtures named in `$sources` (a key outside it is additive drift). `views`: per recorded view, the entity key sets, enum values and array-length ranges of the committed anonymised fixtures (the in-call detector's manifest; never hand-edited). Regenerate both only after re-recording: scripts/dev/with-node.sh npx tsx scripts/probe.ts --rebaseline. tests/drift asserts required ⊆ observed and that `observed` and `views` are current.
